options.O1: Research engineer on the science team of a large AI lab
options.O2: Founding ML engineer at a seven-person biotech startup
options.O3: PhD with a newly hired assistant professor in protein ML
options.O4: One independent year growing an open-source protein-ML toolkit

dimensions.learning: How much durable skill and judgment it builds
dimensions.upside: If it works, how much does it matter in 10 years
dimensions.optionality: How much this path preserves future choices if it doesn't work out
dimensions.fit: Fit with the user's stated interests and constraints

overall: The persona's own overall score, weighted by the persona's own values; not the average of dimensions.
lever_allocation: Split 100 points across L1…L5: which factors will most decide the outcome for Alex.

named_questions.Q1: Does a PhD still pay off when much frontier ML work happens in industry labs?
named_questions.Q2: Under which conditions is the independent year (O4) the right call?

Q2.question: Under which conditions is the independent year (O4) the right call?

conditions.C2: An active user community already exists
conditions.C3: A senior mentor reviews progress monthly
conditions.C4: An offer can be deferred or re-opened

aggregation.primary: Per option: median, IQR, min, max of persona `overall`. Sort by median; ties go to the smaller IQR.
aggregation.sensitivity: Flag options whose rank moves 3+ places across weight sets.
aggregation.baselines: Reported separately; never pooled into the medians.
